title: Import
notAllowed: You need brand administrator access to manage imports.
loadFailed: The import data could not be loaded.
createFailed: The import could not be created. Try again.

new.title: New import
new.caption: Choose where your history is now. Connectors read through the source API; files work with other tools.
new.unavailable: This connector is not available on this install.

descriptions.zendesk: Tickets, comments, users, organizations, ratings and Guide articles.
descriptions.freshdesk: Tickets, conversations, contacts, companies, ratings and Solutions.
descriptions.zohodesk: Tickets, threads, contacts, accounts, departments and the knowledge base.
descriptions.file: Upload CSV files or a Helpdock import bundle and map the columns.

history.title: Imports
history.caption: Open a run to review its progress. A completed run can be repeated as a delta sync.
history.emptyBody: Bring your ticket history, contacts and articles. Importing does not notify customers.

connection.title: Connect to the source
connection.caption: Use read access to the account you want to migrate.
connection.fileCaption: Give this legacy dataset a stable label before uploading its export.
connection.invalid: Check the connection fields and download hostnames.
connection.failed: The connection was refused or could not be reached. Check the credentials and try again.
connection.secretHint: Encrypted on the server and deleted when the import ends.
connection.datasetHint: Use lowercase letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens. Reuse this label for repeats and deltas of the same dataset.
connection.hostsHint: Exact hostnames only, separated by spaces or commas. Add external attachment hosts you trust; do not enter URLs or wildcards.
connection.freshdeskCaption: Use an administrator API key with access to all source tickets.
connection.csatApiHint: Choose the satisfaction system enabled in your Freshdesk account. Access errors stop the import.

zoho.caption: Use a Zoho Desk Administrator account with read, export, recycle-bin and all-department access. The OAuth grant also needs Desk.permissions.READ and Desk.basic.READ; see the import guide for all scopes. The connection check includes a satisfaction query costing 50 Zoho API credits.

scope.title: What to bring
scope.caption: Select the records to extract. Related history must include its parent records.
scope.failed: Extraction could not start. Check the connection and ensure every source file has passed validation.
scope.reports: Rebuild reports for all imported history
scope.numbers: Imported tickets get new Helpdock numbers. Their original numbers remain searchable. SLA timers stay off until you explicitly start them.

run.title: {{source}} import
run.quiet: Customers are not notified. You can leave this page and return to check progress.
run.cancelBody: Stop further import work? Records already imported will remain. Stored credentials will be deleted.
run.actionFailed: The action could not be completed. Refresh the run before trying again.
run.failed: The import stopped after an error. Review its log before starting a new run.

dryRun.title: Dry run
dryRun.caption: Nothing has been imported. Review the counts, warnings and sample tickets before continuing.
dryRun.stale: This report is out of date. Run the dry run again before importing.
dryRun.previewFailed: Ticket samples could not be loaded. Refresh the run before importing.
dryRun.failed: The dry-run report could not be loaded. Try again.
dryRun.errors: Blocking issues to fix before importing: {{count}}.
dryRun.clear: The dry run found no blocking issues.
dryRun.issue: Review this source record before importing.
dryRun.shown: Issues shown: {{shown}} / {{count}}. Totals include issues outside this sample.
dryRun.acknowledge: I have reviewed the warnings and accept the listed changes.
dryRun.emptyPreview: No ticket samples are available for this scope.
dryRun.history: {{count}} messages and notes in the source history

fileStates.not_checked: Not checked in the current dry run

dryRun.emptyContacts: No contact samples are available for this scope.
dryRun.refusedPhones: {{count}} phone numbers could not be normalized and will be omitted.
dryRun.callingCodeHint: Digits only, without + (for example, 963). Leave blank to omit ambiguous national numbers. Run the dry run again after changing this value.

issues.mapping: Choose an available Helpdock value for this source value.
issues.author: Choose how to preserve this source author: an existing person, an invited person, or their name only.
issues.identity: More than one contact or organization could match. Resolve the conflicting identities before continuing.
issues.phone: This phone number could not be normalized and will be omitted. Check the default country calling code.
issues.fieldCapacity: This import would exceed the custom-field limit. Map to existing fields or skip some fields.
issues.fieldConflict: Two field definitions conflict. Choose separate fields or correct their mapping.
issues.reference: A related source record or Helpdock destination is missing. Include it in the import or correct the mapping.
issues.media: The source no longer serves this attachment. Its absence will be recorded in the import history.
issues.mediaSafety: This file fails the brand's size, type or content safety checks. Review the file or the brand's file policy.
issues.mediaUnreachable: The file URL could not be reached under this install's outbound safety rules. Check source host access.
issues.skippedRows: This source file skips rows with validation errors. Review its omitted-row count before importing.

mapping.title: Review mappings
mapping.caption: Match source values to Helpdock. Suggestions are saved only when you confirm this page. Changing a mapping requires a new dry run.
mapping.empty: No source values for this mapping type.
mapping.saveFailed: The mappings could not be saved or refreshed. Retry before continuing.
mapping.unsaved: Save or discard your changes before switching pages or running a dry run.
mapping.proposed: Suggested mapping. Confirm this page to save it.
mapping.emailRequired: An email address is required to create an invited person.
mapping.noInvitation: No invitation email is sent. You can send one later from Staff.
mapping.invalidDefinition: Use a valid field key and label. Source fields with unsupported options must be corrected or mapped to a compatible existing field; no options are silently removed.
mapping.createOnImport: The field is created when the import starts. Reviewing mappings does not create it.

files.title: Files
files.caption: Upload separate CSV files for tickets, messages and contacts, or one Helpdock import bundle. Source files stay private.
files.limit: Choose a non-empty file up to 2 GiB. A bundle must be the only file in the run.
files.failed: The file action failed. Refresh the file list and try again.
files.removeBody: Remove this source file from the run? You can upload it again before extracting records.
files.invalid: This file could not be read safely. Correct the export and upload it again.
files.needsMapping: Map this file’s columns before extracting records.
files.notReady: Every source file must finish preparation and pass mapping validation before extraction.

columns.title: Map the columns
columns.caption: Choose a destination for each column, or skip it. Review the first values and explicitly choose any transforms. Duplicating a rule lets one source column fill more than one field.
columns.constantHint: New constants are text. Add a number, boolean or structured-data transform when needed.
columns.duplicate: Use these columns for another field
columns.previewStale: The mapping has changed. Validate it to refresh the preview.
columns.previewCaption: Showing {{shown}} rows. Checked {{checked}} rows; {{invalid}} contain errors.
columns.invalidRows: Correct the reported rows before extraction. No source records have been staged.
columns.invalidRecord: This row could not be mapped.
columns.saveFailed: The mapping or preset could not be saved. Check the fields and try again.
columns.presetsFailed: Saved presets could not be loaded.
columns.choosePreset: Choose a preset for these columns
columns.invalidMapping: Map at least one field. Each destination must be unique, and all source columns and transform settings must be valid.

errors.type-mismatch: The value has the wrong type.
errors.unmapped-value: The value has no mapping or is not an allowed URL.
errors.invalid-date: The date or timezone is invalid or ambiguous.
errors.invalid-columns: The row has an unexpected number of columns.
errors.missing-column: A mapped source column is missing.

columns.skippedRows: Rows with errors will be skipped. The dry run will require acknowledgment of these omissions before importing.

log.title: Import log
log.liveCaption: Recent entries appear here while the run works. Open older pages to inspect a fixed snapshot.
log.snapshotCaption: Viewing a fixed log snapshot. Return to the latest entries to follow progress.
log.downloadFailed: The log could not be downloaded. Try again.
log.empty: No log entries match this filter.
log.other: Import diagnostic. Use the code below when investigating this record.
log.skippedRows: {{count}} rows with validation errors were explicitly skipped.

messages.inactiveProfile: An accessible source contact or company is marked deleted, trashed or spam. Its historical data and flags are retained for review; no local record is deleted and no access is granted.
messages.historyPageChanged: Source history changed while a saved page was being resumed. Extraction stopped to avoid missing or duplicating records. Freeze source changes and start a fresh import.
messages.descriptionFallback: A ticket description has no matching source thread. It is retained as private history without an assumed author or original visibility. Review it in the preview.
messages.fullContentInferred: A complete source body was read as UTF-8 HTML or plain text using its response content type. Zoho does not document that response envelope; verify the thread in the preview.
messages.articleFilesEnvelopeInferred: Zoho returned article files in a list envelope that differs from its documentation example. Each file was checked against the versioned article detail; review the files in the preview.
messages.identityUnavailable: The original author name is retained, but the source does not establish a stable identity. This message will not be attributed to a local user.
messages.unsentThread: A draft, failed or pending source reply is retained as private history with its original status. It will not be sent.
messages.fullContentUnsupported: The source returned an unsupported or incomplete full-thread body. Extraction stopped to prevent truncated history.
messages.recordUnavailable: The source record is no longer available.
messages.vendorUnavailable: The source service could not be reached. The run will retry or report a failure.
messages.attachmentUnavailable: The source no longer serves this attachment.
messages.attachmentRejected: An attachment was refused by the file safety checks.
messages.articleAssetUnavailable: An article file is unavailable or was refused by the file safety checks. The article includes an availability message.
messages.articleDescriptionShortened: An article description was shortened for display. The full working and published source descriptions are retained.
messages.unknownMapping: A source value needs an explicit mapping.
messages.unsupportedField: A source field uses behavior Helpdock cannot preserve directly.
messages.inferredDate: A rating date was inferred from the available source history.
messages.normalizedRating: A source satisfaction rating was converted to the Helpdock scale.
messages.timestampWindowExhausted: Freshdesk returned too many tickets at the same change timestamp. A complete export inventory is required to continue safely.
messages.zohoTimestampWindowExhausted: Zoho returned too many tickets within an indivisible change-time window. Supply a complete ticket ID inventory to continue safely.
messages.zohoArchiveWindowExhausted: Zoho's archive pagination limit prevents confirming a complete history for this department. Start a new import with a complete ticket ID inventory.
messages.originalMailUnavailable: Zoho no longer provides the original email for this thread. Its available message body, recipients and attachments are retained, but the original Message-ID cannot be recovered.
messages.mailDateUnparsed: The original email date could not be parsed. Its source text is retained in message details; the timeline keeps the source thread date.
messages.authorUnavailable: The source identifies this as a staff message but does not identify its original author.
messages.knowledgeLocaleUnsupported: The source knowledge languages cannot be represented safely in this English/Arabic installation. Review the source language settings before importing knowledge.
messages.unmappedRating: Original satisfaction answers will be preserved without a comparable score and excluded from rating averages.

sla.title: SLA clocks
sla.caption: Optional: start clocks for open imported tickets from {{source}}. This covers the source account, including earlier runs.
sla.failedRequest: The activation request could not be saved. Refresh and try again.
sla.failed: Activation stopped after an error. Retry to continue from the last saved batch; clocks already started will not be reset.
sla.counts: Checked {{checked}} tickets · started {{started}} · skipped {{skipped}}. Tickets without a matching SLA policy are skipped.
sla.unavailable: SLA activation is available after a connected import completes.
sla.start: Start SLA clocks for {{count}} open tickets
sla.confirm: Start applicable SLA clocks for open imported tickets from {{source}}? There are currently {{count}} candidates. This includes earlier runs from the same account and excludes tickets imported after this request. Original history dates stay unchanged. Configured SLA timers and escalations will begin; the job continues if you leave this page.

inventory.useFallback: Use a reviewed ticket ID inventory instead of automatic archive discovery
inventory.zohoAutomaticHint: Zoho tickets and archives are discovered automatically across enabled and disabled departments. Use a reviewed inventory if a source API limit requires it. A capped or incomplete scan stops before importing.
inventory.title: Source ticket inventory
inventory.caption: Upload CSV exports containing the native ticket IDs needed for complete migration. The files stay private.
inventory.mappingHint: Choose the API ticket ID column. Zoho ticket numbers are separate from API IDs. Every row is validated before extraction.
inventory.validated: {{records}} unique ticket IDs validated · {{duplicates}} duplicate rows
inventory.previewHint: This preview shows up to 20 source rows. Validation checks the whole file.

modes.archives: Archive IDs plus the live export

inventory.modeHint: Archive coverage adds these IDs to the live API export. Complete coverage uses the supplied IDs for every ticket and avoids vendor list limits.
inventory.confirm: I confirm these files cover every ticket required by the selected coverage. I will supply a fresh export for each delta.
inventory.invalidRow: Check the source ticket ID at row {{row}}. Correct the ID-column mapping or replace the file.
